description: Source code for Leave Encashment functionality in ERPNext, including class definition, validation, and ledger entry creation.

classes.name: LeaveEncashment
classes.description: A Document class representing leave encashment records, with methods for validation, submission, cancellation, and ledger entry management.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates employee details, leave details, and salary structure before processing.

methods.name: validate_salary_structure
methods.description: Checks if the employee has an assigned salary structure.

methods.name: before_submit
methods.description: Ensures encashment amount is valid before submission.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Processes leave encashment, creates additional salary record, updates leave allocation, and ledger entries.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Reverses encashment effects, cancels salary, and updates ledger entries.

methods.name: get_leave_details_for_encashment
methods.description: Calculates leave balance, encashable days, and amount based on leave allocation and salary structure.

methods.name: get_leave_allocation
methods.description: Retrieves leave allocation details for the employee and leave type.

methods.name: create_leave_ledger_entry
methods.description: Creates ledger entries for encashed leaves and reversals if applicable.
